chunks: Of molten pitch shall be their garments, their faces covered with flames,
ai.seo_question: What are the garments and facial covering of the disbelievers in Hell according to Surah Ibrahim?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (14:50) is often interpreted as a consequence of the disbelievers' rejection of the Imams and the truth, where 'garments of pitch' symbolize the sticky adherence to falsehood that envelops them. The fire covering their faces signifies the loss of their spiritual vision and dignity, contrasting with the radiant faces of the faithful. This imagery underscores the physical manifestation of their internal spiritual corruption in the Hereafter.
